# SS6PlayerForWeb

Source: https://github.com/SpriteStudio/SS6PlayerForWeb

Pinned commit: `934a920553694836a3fd96bef75e84e02c63feb4`

Versions: ss6player-pixi 2.4.1, ss6player-lib 1.0.6, ssfblib 1.2.6.

Only the three packages' source directories are included. The source is
unmodified. The build resolves the `@resourceLoader` alias to this plugin's
loader to keep cell-map names private to each project. See ../../src/resource-loader.ts.
The original license is retained in LICENSE.
